info.name: WIN-CASINO API Tests
info.description: Postman collection for WIN-CASINO REST API. Contains positive and negative tests for /api endpoints with automated assertions.

exec: pm.test('Status is 200', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });
pm.test('Response is JSON', function () { pm.response.to.be.json; });

pm.test('Has success or error field', function () { const json = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(json).to.be.an('object'); pm.expect(json).to.satisfy(j => j.hasOwnProperty('success') || j.hasOwnProperty('error')); });

pm.test('If success then username and balance exist', function () { const j = pm.response.json(); if (j.success) { pm.expect(j).to.have.property('username'); pm.expect(j).to.have.property('balance'); } });
pm.test('Status is 200', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });

pm.test('Has success true and result array', function () { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j).to.have.property('success'); if (j.success) { pm.expect(j).to.have.property('result'); pm.expect(j.result).to.be.an('array'); pm.expect(j).to.have.property('new_balance'); pm.expect(j).to.have.property('win'); } else { pm.expect(j).to.have.property('error'); } });
pm.test('Status is 200 (API returns JSON errors with 200)', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });
pm.test('Error message for invalid bet', function () { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j).to.have.property('error'); pm.expect(j.error).to.match(/Ставка/); });
pm.test('Status 200', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });

pm.test('Response JSON and has expected keys', function () { const j = pm.response.json(); if (j.success) { pm.expect(j).to.have.keys(['success','result','bet','win','new_balance']); } else { pm.expect(j).to.have.property('error'); } });

item.name: Spin - GET excessive bet (likely insufficient funds)

exec: pm.test('Status 200', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });

pm.test('Expect insufficient funds error or success depending on env', function () { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j).to.be.an('object'); if (j.error) { pm.expect(j.error).to.match(/Недостатньо/); } else { pm.expect(j).to.have.property('new_balance'); } });
pm.test('Status 200', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });

pm.test('Bonanza success structure', function () { const j = pm.response.json(); if (j.success) { pm.expect(j).to.have.property('grid'); pm.expect(j.grid).to.be.an('array'); pm.expect(j).to.have.property('win'); pm.expect(j).to.have.property('new_balance'); pm.expect(j).to.have.property('winning_symbols'); pm.expect(j).to.have.property('bonus_game'); } else { pm.expect(j).to.have.property('error'); } });
pm.test('Invalid bet returns error', function () { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j).to.have.property('error'); pm.expect(j.error).to.match(/Ставка/); });
pm.test('Status 200', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });

pm.test('Rocket returns crash_point and new_balance', function () { const j = pm.response.json(); if (j.success) { pm.expect(j).to.have.property('crash_point'); pm.expect(j.crash_point).to.be.a('number'); pm.expect(j).to.have.property('new_balance'); } else { pm.expect(j).to.have.property('error'); } });
pm.test('Invalid bet yields error', function () { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j).to.have.property('error'); pm.expect(j.error).to.match(/Некоректна ставка/); });
pm.test('Follow redirect returns JSON', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); pm.response.to.be.json; });
pm.test('Has result or error', function () { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j).to.be.an('object'); pm.expect(j).to.satisfy(o => o.success || o.error); });
pm.test('Expect 404 or non-200', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.code).to.be.oneOf([200,404,302,500]); });
